name: Travis Koenig
bio:
Travis Koenig is an adept tattoo artist specializing in neotraditional and floral designs, bringing each piece to life with exceptional skill and creativity. Operating out of Bound by Design in Denver, Colorado, Travis is renowned for maintaining the highest standards of cleanliness, ensuring a safe and sterile environment for every client's tattoo experience. His dedication to hygiene complements his artistic talent, making him a sought-after artist for those valuing both artistry and health safety.
